overview.text: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT-Delhi) invites sealed bids for conducting the Post Graduate Computer Science & Engineering Admission Test (PGCAT-IIITD) on a pan-India level. The tender ID is IIIT-D/Acad./Test/001/2026-27 and the RFP was issued by IIIT-Delhi. An earnest money deposit (EMD) of Rs. 50,000/- must be deposited in the form of a demand draft; this amount is exempted for MSMEs/NSIC registered suppliers.

issuing_organization: Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi

scope.text: The bidder must submit a performance bank guarantee (PBG) equivalent to 5% of the PO value within 15 days from the date of Purchase Order.
The PBG must be in favour of 'IIIT-Delhi Collections' and payable at New Delhi, valid for 60 days beyond the stipulated cessation date.
The bidder is required to appoint a dedicated Single Point of Contact (SPOC) or Project Manager responsible for overseeing execution and delivery.
The offered solution must have capability to make changes or customize the platform as per IIIT-Delhi requirements.
In the event of SLA breach, a penalty of Rs. 5000/- per day is levied for the first seven days, and Rs. 8000/- per day from the 8th day onwards.
The bidder must ensure an emergency management plan for server/node management, additional locations, and student/applicant data failure.
The bidder must provide uninterrupted power supply (UPS) to IT infrastructure at every test center and guarantee generator availability.
The organization must maintain documented test cases and evidence of successful test execution covering all test cases by QA professionals.
Testing must cover performance, security, Usability, High Availability, Business Continuity, and disaster recovery beyond system features.
The bidder is strictly prohibited from disclosing the applicant's database to any third party or individual.
The bidder must design a high-performance system and make performance test results available for each major release of the exam system.
The bidder must design a secure system, conduct security tests on source code, binaries, and infrastructure, and provide security test results per major release.
Conducting PGCAT Exam as per scope of work.
The quote should include all taxes/charges and installation at IIIT-Delhi campus.
The rate quoted shall remain valid for a period of 60 days from the last date of the tender document, i.e., 60 days from 23rd February 2026.

key_requirements.text: The contractor must undertake to comply with all relevant laws including Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition) Act, 1970; Employees' State Insurance Acts; Minimum Wages Act, 1948; Payment of Bonus Act, 1972; Payment of Wages Act, 1936; Income Tax Act; GST Act etc.
The contractor must indemnify the IIITD from its acts of omission or commission regarding compliance with relevant laws.

Sealed quotations shall be received no later than 12.00 Noon on 9th March, 2026.

PGCAT-IIITD Exam for CSE and CSE-Research: Sunday, May 3, 2026
Sharing of Result (Raw data): Sunday, May 3, 2026

commercial_requirements.text: Bidder must deposit an earnest money (EMD) of Rs.50,000/- in the form of a demand draft.
Tender Document Fee is Rs.1,180/- excluding tender document fee cost mentioned as Rs.1000 +18% GST
Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) of Five percent (5%) of contract value.

The bid document must include details such as Name of the vendor, Address, Telephone/Mobile numbers, E-Mail address, Details of Registration, Date of formation/incorporation, Type of organization, and Average Annual Turnover of Last Three Financial Years.
All documents must be encoupled; in case of firm, partnership deed, Articles of Association or Affidavit is required.
The bidder shall furnish an undertaking on company letterhead regarding Blacklisting/Non-debarment for the last 3 years.
The Proforma Financial Bid must quote costs in INR only, inclusive of all taxes, charges, and installation at IIIT-Delhi campus.
The Bidder quote in financial Bid should be INR only.
Please note the price should be quoted for each of the items and should be inclusive of all taxes/charges and installation at IIIT-Delhi.
The discount, if any, should be mentioned herein and nowhere else.
It is certified that the rates quoted above are not more than the rates charged from any Central / State Govt. Deptt. / Institution / GeM.

important_conditions.text: In case of breach (failure to submit PBG within 15 days or assigning sub-contract), the bidder shall be notified as blacklisted.
Upon placing of Purchase Order, successful Bidder must submit a Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) equivalent to 5% of the PO value. No interest is payable on the PBG.
The PBG will be valid for 60 days beyond the stipulated date for cessation of the contract, which is co-terminus with the warranty period.
In case of failure leading to re-examination, the cost of the second examination shall be borne by the bidder.
Penalty of Rs. 5000/- per day for first seven days of SLA breach, and Rs. 8,000/- per day from 8th day onwards.
The successful vendor shall not assign the sub-contract. In case of breach, IIIT-Delhi may rescind the contract.
If the vendor fails to complete work within specified period, they are liable to pay compensation at 1% per week subject to a maximum of 10% of the contract amount.
The Institute may terminate the contract for default/substantial breach uncorrected within 15 days by giving 30 days written notice, or at any time with one month's notice without assigning reason.
In case of earlier termination, the Performance Security Deposit shall stand forfeited by the Institute.
Upon expiry or earlier termination, the vendor must return all materials and equipment belonging to the Institute.
The Institute is entitled to recover extra costs (execution, remedying defects, completion) from the Contractor, adjusted against the Performance Security Deposit.
All disputes shall be referred to the Director IIIT-Delhi for decision. If unsatisfied, dispute shall be settled by arbitration in Delhi under Indian law.
The bidder is strictly prohibited from disclosing the applicant's database to any third party or individual.
The selected bidder must sign an agreement with IIITD on stamp paper after issue of Purchase/Work order.
